Author: flowinternals
Message:
Stage 1 - Added SecLens report-quality validation & critic

Introduce SecLens report-quality gating and an optional critic repair pass. Adds output contract v2, evidence rules, phased analysis, and critic prompts; implements comprehensive Markdown report validation (reportValidation.js) and a ReportQualityGateError type. Integrates validation and critic flow into the OpenAI client and /api/analyze handler (telemetry, correlation IDs, 422 response on quality-gate failure). Adds environment controls (SECLENS_CRITIC_ENABLED, model overrides, token caps) and documents them in README; includes test fixtures and vitest config for validation tests. Also adds helper to redact leakage, token accounting, and related utilities. Package/dev tooling updated for testing.
